name: levels/level-1-kid-mismatch
description: Negative fixture: the DOMAIN_VERIFIED AgentCard with a DNS TXT record whose kid field (agent-e5f6a7b8) differs from the declared publicKey.kid (agent-a1b2c3d4). Record name, agent name, and fingerprint all match. A conforming verifier MUST reject on the key ID binding before computing the fingerprint: the record endorses a key under a different identifier than the one the AgentCard declares. Models a card whose declared key ID drifted from the published record, for example after a key rotation that was not reflected in DNS.

spec.section: §1 Agent Identity Verification Levels — Level 1 DNS Verification (kid binding)
